items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: C. L. Burke had the band out at the place called the Bell Tavern at that time

ctx.x: Oscar Bradley. And -- funny, I can't remember the other guys, isn't it funny, offhand. It'll come to me. But then you had C. L. Burke, he was around. You had I think C. L. Burke had the band out at the place called the Bell Tavern at that time. They had shows. And of course Les Hite was out at the Cotton Club with a big band, and then that band was Peppy Prince who's still around. Peppy was the drummer for them and also doing vocalizing. A very fine vocalist and drummer. And you had -- let's see, who else was --…

trumpeter. Lloyd's gone. Then you had George Orendorff. George Orendorff is still around, a very fine trumpet player. And -- I can't remember the other guys, offhand, but quite a few of the guys are still around, the older guys.
